_comment_block_builtins: HOOK: block-bash-builtins — forces Claude to use Grep/Read/Glob tools
instead of shelling out to grep/cat/find/head/tail/sed/awk.

_comment_block_destructive: HOOK: block-destructive — blocks rm -rf, git push --force, git reset --hard,
and other hard-to-reverse commands. Claude must ask explicitly before proceeding.
TUNE: Edit .claude/hooks/block-destructive.sh to add/remove blocked patterns,
add allowed exceptions, or disable the hook entirely.

_comment_stop_verify: HOOK: stop-verify — blocks Claude from stopping if any source file (.c/.h/.hip/.cu)
was modified more recently than STATUS.md. Forces STATUS.md update after every unit.
On the SECOND stop attempt (stop_hook_active=true), always allows stop to prevent loops.
TUNE: Edit .claude/hooks/stop-verify.sh to change SOURCE_PATTERNS, REFERENCE_FILE,
MAX_FILES_LISTED, BLOCK_REASON, or to disable the hook entirely.

_comment_notify: HOOK: notify — sends a desktop notification via notify-send (libnotify) whenever
Claude emits a Notification event (e.g., task complete, input needed).
Falls back to a terminal bell if notify-send is not installed.
TUNE: Edit .claude/hooks/notify.sh to change NOTIFY_TITLE, NOTIFY_URGENCY,
NOTIFY_TIMEOUT_MS, NOTIFY_ICON, FALLBACK_BELL, or to enable file logging.

_comment_compact_reinject: HOOK: compact-reinject — after auto-compaction, re-injects STATUS.md and
a protocol reminder so Claude always has its session navigator after compaction.
matcher 'compact' means this ONLY fires on compaction, not on normal session start.
TUNE: Edit .claude/hooks/compact-reinject.sh to control which files are injected,
whether git log is included, and the reminder message text.

_comment_thinking_tokens: MAX_THINKING_TOKENS: caps extended thinking (internal reasoning) per request.
Default when unset: ~31,000 tokens (very expensive for routine coding tasks).
Set to 8000 for most coding tasks — sufficient for non-trivial reasoning.
Set to 16000 for architectural planning (PLAN.md, algorithm trade-off analysis).
Set to 1000-3000 for simple edits and single-file changes.
Set to 0 to disable extended thinking entirely (fastest, cheapest).
Set to 31000 to restore the default for complex architectural decisions.
WARNING: this is a string value, not a number.

_comment_permissions: Permission rules are evaluated: deny → ask → allow (deny always wins).
WARNING: Bash deny patterns have known reliability issues in some versions.
The PreToolUse hooks above are the reliable enforcement mechanism.
These deny rules are a secondary layer for defense-in-depth.

deny._comment: Deny direct git push to main/master without going through hooks.
Deny git push --force unconditionally (hook also blocks this).
